text:
**紧急诏书 · EMERGENCY IMPERIAL EDICT — ON THE GREAT EPIDEMIC**
Issued by the Son of Heaven · 2026-08-04 · Binding on all offices of the realm

**I. DECLARATION OF STATE EMERGENCY**
A virulent epidemic sweeps the major cities, killing five to ten percent of the population each month. The Court declares this a state emergency of the highest order. All ordinary business of the realm yields to epidemic response until this edict is rescinded by the Throne.

**II. EMERGENCY AND QUARANTINE POWERS, WITH LIMITS**
- Cities are authorized to impose quarantine, restrict movement between districts and between cities, suspend markets and assemblies, and requisition buildings as isolation facilities.
- Limits: powers last only for the duration of this emergency and apply only within the issuing city. No dwelling may be destroyed without authorization of the 太宰; no household may be sealed without provision of food and water; no official may use the emergency to seize property, settle private scores, or levy unauthorized taxes. Actions beyond these limits revert to the Court. The 司寇 audits all exercises of these powers.

**III. CENTRAL COMMAND**
- The 太宰 is appointed to run the central response apparatus: coordinating personnel, supplies, funds, and information across all cities. All bureaus obey his direction.
- The 太师 is charged with technical planning: diagnosis, medicine, isolation methods, burial protocol, and all matters of healing. His technical rulings are binding on all cities.

**IV. COMMAND TO THE 诸侯**
Every 诸侯 shall personally direct the response in his own city: quarantine, isolation wards, medicine distribution, food relief, and burial services. Each city sends a daily report to the 太宰 — new cases, deaths, supplies spent, needs — no later than dusk. Silence and delay are alike forbidden.

**V. TREASURY AND GRANARIES**
Treasury funds are released for medicine, physicians, gravediggers, and isolation facilities. State granaries are opened for food relief to the quarantined and destitute, and for dignified burial of the dead. The 太宰 administers disbursement; the 司寇 audits it.

**VI. GUIDING PRINCIPLES**
1. Saving lives is the first priority, above revenue, ceremony, and convenience.
2. One unified chain of reporting: city → 太宰 → Throne. No parallel or conflicting channels.
3. Officials who conceal, under-report, or falsify case numbers will be punished without leniency.
4. Relief must reach the poor — the old, the orphaned, and the beggar are not to be excluded.

The 司寇 shall supervise compliance throughout. This edict is dispatched by express courier to all cities and proclaimed at every gate.

**钦此。**

5. Logistics requirements: what the 太宰 must procure (medicine, grain, tents, lime, carts, protective cloth) and in what rough quantities per 100k population.

text:
EPIDEMIC_RESPONSE_PLAN // 太師 TECHNICAL EDICT v1.0 // BINDING ALL CITIES

[1] SURVEILLANCE & CASE DEFINITION
- Case classes: S=suspect(fever+cough OR contact with case); P=probable(S + district cluster); C=confirmed(physician-verified symptom pattern). Count only C toward mortality rate.
- Every ward appoints a case-finder; daily dawn count → district ledger → city registry, one-line format: date/ward/class/age/outcome.
- Unified weekly report due day 7;司寇 audits ledgers for undercount by sampling burials vs. registry.

[2] CONTAINMENT LAYER (triggers → actions)
- T1 (≥3 C in one ward, 7d): cordon ward; suspend its market; pass permits only for water/grain/medicine.
- T2 (≥10 C or 2 wards): close city markets, temples, assemblies; halt festivals; gate entry restricted to freight with inspection.
- T3 (mortality >1%/wk citywide): full movement freeze; house-to-house case-finding; inter-city travel banned except logistics under 太宰 seal.
- De-escalate only after 2 consecutive weeks of declining C counts.

[3] ISOLATION & TREATMENT
- Two-tier wards: MILD halls (temples/barracks converted; 1 physician per 40 patients; 1 attendant per 10, masked, gowned, no home contact for 7d) vs SEVERE pavilions (1 physician per 10; priority: treatable first, comfort-only last).
- Triage rule: breathing distress + not feeding → severe; else mild home-isolation with daily check.
- NEVER mix mild/severe; caregivers rotate 7d on / 7d observed off; any caregiver with fever isolates immediately.
- Stockpile per 100k: antipyretic herbs 300 jin, porridge/rice-water provisions, clean-water rations for wards.

[4] SANITATION & BURIAL
- Water: boil or lime-treat all drinking water in affected wards; wells near burial grounds closed.
- Waste: latrines lime-dusted daily; sick-room waste burned.
- Burial: body wrapped in lime-soaked cloth, no washing rites, no assembly; inter within 24h, pit ≥6尺 deep, lime layer below and above; mourners ≤5, at distance. Death certificates require cause class for registry.

[5] LOGISTICS REQUIREMENT TO 太宰 (per 100k population, 30-day horizon)
- Grain: 900石 (feed isolated + caregivers)
- Tents/timber: 200 field-hall kits
- Lime: 20,000斤 (water, waste, burial)
- Cloth: 60,000 masks + 8,000 gowns
- Carts: 50 dedicated corpse/freight carts, never food use
- Herbs: 300 jin antipyretic + reserve

[6] SUCCESS METRICS (weekly review to 天子)
- Primary: weekly C-count and mortality trend declining 2 wks running.
- Secondary: % cases isolated within 2d of onset ≥80%; caregiver infection rate <5%; burial-within-24h ≥95%; zero city without registry.
- Failure trigger: any metric worsening 2 wks → escalate one tier + 司寇 investigation.

END_PLAN

COMPLIANCE_AUDIT_ENFORCEMENT_FRAMEWORK // 司寇 (Minister of Justice) // epidemic emergency

1. AUDIT_SCOPE
- quarantine_powers: every sealing/demolition order checked against edict limits (city-bound, emergency-bound; 太宰 authorization required for dwelling destruction; sealed households must show food/water provision logs).
- requisitions: grain, goods, labor — each with written warrant, recipient signature, compensation record.
- disbursements: granary/treasury outflows matched to named beneficiary rolls, prioritizing poor relief.
- report_truth: city case/death tallies cross-checked three-way: registration teams ⟷ burial/cemetery records ⟷ relief-ration draws. Discrepancy >5% triggers investigation.

2. METHODS
- Inspector circuits: one 司寇 circuit per city, rotating every 2 weeks; inspectors never serve their home city.
- Ledger-to-physical checks: reconcile written ledgers with counted grain stocks, sealed-household counts, burial plots.
- Unannounced visits: ≥2 per city per week, at checkpoints, granaries, quarantined streets; night visits permitted.
- Petition channel: sealed-complaint boxes at city gates + oral petitions to circuit inspectors; informants' names sealed from local officials; retaliation against petitioners = offense (3c).

3. OFFENSE_SCHEDULE (graded)
(a) Concealment/falsification of numbers: minor (<5% discrepancy, negligence) → demotion + fine; deliberate or >5% → dismissal + exile; falsification causing deaths or hindering relief → capital referral to Throne.
(b) Embezzlement of relief: <10% shortfall → double restitution + dismissal; >10% or repeat → exile; starving the poor to profit → capital referral.
(c) Abuse of quarantine power (sealing without provision, unauthorized demolition, private score-settling, seizure): restitution + flogging for minor; dismissal + exile for severe; death of household members → capital referral.
(d) Checkpoint-guard dereliction: absence/laxity → pay forfeiture + extra duty; letting persons/goods pass for bribe → dismissal + flogging; knowingly passing infected → exile.

4. PROTECTIONS_DUE_PROCESS
- Audits must not halt relief: inspectors may observe and record but may not freeze disbursements already approved; only 司寇 with 太宰 countersign may suspend an official.
- Fast track: accusations acknowledged within 1 day, resolved within 5 days; emergency duties continue unless suspension ordered.
- Appeal: any accused official may appeal to 太宰 within 3 days; 太宰 ruling final except capital cases, which go to Throne. Malicious false accusation punished symmetrically.

5. WEEKLY_REPORT_FORMAT (to 太宰 and Throne)
- A. Edict-limit compliance by city (violations: count, type, severity)
- B. Requisition/disbursement totals vs ledger, discrepancy rate
- C. Report-truth: registration vs burial vs ration delta per city
- D. Petitions received / resolved / pending
- E. Penalties imposed, appeals filed
- F. Risks and recommended corrective orders.

END_FRAMEWORK
